posts.name: Piyush Kumar
posts.cooked:
I have bought my laptop in July 2025 but there is an internet disconnection problem in it. Whenever I connect it to my mobile hotspot or even a Wifi, it either gets disconnected after sometime or shows no internet. I have more or less tried every solution available on the internet but can’t fix it. So, I use usb tethering to access internet.

Now, my question is, Is it alright if I use a phone and a usb cable for my pc during the OPPE?

posts.name: Arun
posts.cooked:
I’m not sure but I doubt they will allow having a phone on your desk for any reason during OPPE.

If your router is in the same room you can use ethernet cable.

Else, you can consider getting an external wifi dongle for better reception.

posts.name: SELEENAMMA JOSEPH
posts.cooked: it is possible you just have to tell the proctor the issue before hand and as long as you don’t sign out of both your system and phone ,its alright the proctor will allow you to rejoin

posts.name: Piyush Kumar
posts.cooked: I hope so… I was too desperate earlier… thanks for your clarification
